description.value: Non-Stop Pizza is a multi-location Indian-fusion pizza restaurant on Fraser Highway in Surrey, offering a broad menu spanning classic and specialty pizzas alongside tandoori items, biryani, wraps, and wings. The Fraser Highway location is one of at least three Lower Mainland outlets and serves both dine-in and delivery customers. Cyclists on this busy arterial corridor would find a wide range of vegetarian and meat options available for a sit-down or takeaway meal.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is a functioning multi-location pizza and Indian-fusion restaurant at 15272 Fraser Hwy, Surrey, with phone 604-588-5252 matching OSM address data. The menu explicitly includes 'VEG SPECIALITIES' and 'VEGGIE PIZZAS' categories supporting vegetarian options, and online ordering/delivery is prominently featured. No evidence of bike parking, washrooms, or water refill appears anywhere on the site or in OSM tags; the website's blog content is largely placeholder lorem ipsum text and has not been substantively updated since mid-2021.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number; phone 604-588-5252 sourced from website only — contact_confirmed.phone set to null.
Website blog posts from June 2020 use lorem ipsum placeholder text ('Pizza ipsum dolor amet...'), and chef biographies are dummy copy; site has not been substantively updated since July 2021.
The July 2021 blog post is WordPress's default 'Hello world!' entry, suggesting minimal ongoing web maintenance.
Website is a multi-location ordering portal; content quality is low and may not accurately reflect current in-store conditions.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business appears operational and is a legitimate food stop on a key cycling corridor, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence. An on-site visit is needed to assess these before listing.
